children.value: > Fact From Story: Australia, in a 49th final, seek a first win in the World Cup of men’s tennis in 20 years.
> > Fact From Story: It will be Australia’s 49th appearance in the Davis Cup final, as they seek the trophy for the 29th time.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If a team is in its 49th final and seeks a first win in 20 years, they have not won in the past 20 years.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The Davis Cup is the World Cup of men’s tennis.
